{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABdBkKTA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhGj540", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 91, "title": "Upgrade the public MMD/glTF demo to published @takahirox/three-mmd 0.1.4", "body": "## Problem

The public MMD vs glTF comparison is still pinned to **`@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.3`**, but the package maintainer has now published **`@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.4`** on npm. Upgrade the demo to the current published package, retaining the existing independently loaded direct-PMX reference and the converter-produced glTF comparison. The maintainer explicitly requests this version upgrade.

**Publication evidence (2026-11-06):** [npm search](https://www.npmjs.com/search?q=%40takahirox%2Fthree-mmd) lists `@takahirox/three-mmd` **0.1.4**. The [upstream repository](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/package.json) has `version: 0.1.4`, peer dependency `three: ~0.186.0`, and retains the public root / `./loaders/MMDLoader.js` / `./effects/MMDOutlineEffect.js` exports. Upstream [Issue #118](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/118) and merged [PR #119](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/119) prepared the release. Re-check the **official npm registry** and actual resolved tarball / integrity when implementing; a repository manifest alone is not proof of a published tarball.

## Current demo state (main `5c8428acedfafe4762aafabda76110bdf7e258b8`)

- [`package.json`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/package.json): `dependencies['@takahirox/three-mmd']` is exactly **`0.1.3`**, while `three` is **`0.186.1`** (within the upstream 0.1.4 peer range).
- [`package-lock.json`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/package-lock.json): root dependency and `node_modules/@takahirox/three-mmd` still resolve to the official **0.1.3 tarball**. Update them together; never edit only the displayed version string.
- [`examples/main.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/main.ts) imports `updateMMDUVs`, `MMDLoader`, and upstream `MMDOutlineEffect` through public npm exports. The direct-PMX (left MMD) reference uses the installed package; the glTF (right) comes from this repository's converter/plugins. Keep these ownership boundaries clear.
- [`README.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/README.md), [`docs/public-motion.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/public-motion.md), and the Gene Light source-rights text in [`examples/index.html`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/index.html) still describe **0.1.3** as the currently installed version. Update *current-version claims* to 0.1.4; preserve historical 0.1.3 evidence, especially [`docs/pmx-resource-paths.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/pmx-resource-paths.md), as explicitly labeled dated history rather than rewriting past validation.
- There are no other open Issues or open PRs as checked for this request.

## Important compatibility consideration: 0.1.4 changes appearance

The upstream release bundles [ambient / scene-lighting revisions](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/119) from upstream PRs #114 and #115. These can change the MMD-reference pane's brightness / HDR clipping relative to the glTF Toon/PBR pane, **even if rendering remains correct**. Do not silently "fix" the difference by altering the glTF converter, shader definitions, lighting configuration, asset textures, tone mapping, or pixel thresholds without a separately justified defect. Preserve the comparison's honest interpretation: it contrasts two implementations, not necessarily bit-identical images. Record before/after visual evidence and explain meaningful expected differences.

## Implementation requirements

- [ ] Confirm `@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.4` is actually available on the official registry at implementation time; verify the exact resolved published package, version, lock integrity and (where available) published `gitHead`. Do not substitute GitHub `main`, a local link or a tarball from an untrusted mirror.
- [ ] Upgrade `package.json` to the **exact** npm dependency version `0.1.4` and regenerate `package-lock.json` using npm so the root and package entry resolve consistently to `@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.4`. Confirm a fresh `npm ci` installs **0.1.4**, with no duplicate 0.1.3 install or unintended unrelated dependency churn.
- [ ] Confirm compatibility with current `three@0.186.1` and the actual package's public exports and types. Preserve `updateMMDUVs`, `MMDLoader`, and `MMDOutlineEffect` import paths; modify integration code only if a real 0.1.4 regression or API incompatibility requires it, with a focused explanation.
- [ ] Ensure both **Uka and Gene Light** direct PMX resource loading, all referenced texture paths (including Uka's original `tex\hair_s01.png` Windows separator), decoded images, outline rendering, SDEF/BDEF behavior and disposal work with the published loader. No temporary 0.1.2 resource-path compatibility shim should be reintroduced.
- [ ] Ensure MMD (direct PMX) and converted glTF remain independent, side by side, with synchronized camera, VMD/vertex expression, IK and Physics behavior, three named source VMDs per character, full source-derived durations, and normal Play/Pause/Restart/Loop/seek. Physics defaults Off and only initializes Ammo when requested; Gene Apology + IK On remains appropriately unavailable. Model/motion/material/Outline switching must not refetch the same model/textures unnecessarily or allocate duplicate renderers.
- [ ] Verify **visual effects of 0.1.4 lighting** against the pinned 0.1.3 demo baseline on both models, with same scene/camera/material/pose and Toon/PBR selection. Note actual MMD-reference changes and whether they match upstream's documented ambient/scene-lighting correction. Preserve important raster and numerical regressions. Do not assert new pixel equality between the MMD and glTF panes, and do not weaken existing tests to hide unexpected failures.
- [ ] Preserve the simplified public UI after PR #90 (no Details sidebar), camera reset, responsive desktop/mobile layout, status/Retry error handling, About/credits, model asset rights, original hashes and downloads. Do not make unrelated UI or dependency upgrades in this task.
- [ ] Update current-version references in the README, current public-motion guidance and example credits, plus a concise version-upgrade validation note identifying exact package version, relevant upstream compatibility changes and tests. Keep historical 0.1.3 release/texture-path records and their original claims unmodified except for clear historical framing if necessary.

## Pre-merge acceptance / validation

- [ ] `npm ci` from a clean install completes, and installed `node_modules/@takahirox/three-mmd/package.json` reports `0.1.4`; package lock and resolved official tarball/integrity agree. Test the *published npm distribution*, not just upstream source.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run check:links` and `git diff --check` pass. Run relevant real-model Playwright suites including Uka/Gene PMX texture-resource loading/Retry, comparison viewer, animations/source duration, IK, Physics, Outline, Toon/PBR, model switching, mobile layout and hidden rig conformance. Preserve existing required GPU/pixel/physics checks and the four-shard CI from PR #82.
- [ ] Compare deterministic reference-pane captures / numerical behavior before (0.1.3) and after (0.1.4) at representative Uka/Gene Rest and body-motion frames, with Outline on/off and material variants where meaningful. Attach reproducible evidence and distinguish expected brightness/lighting changes from any functional regression. Do not demand native hardware/physical Android or subjective human signoff as a routine pre-merge blocker; record untested platforms honestly.
- [ ] Verify `0.1.4` does not regress Android-adjacent PMX path handling, failure/Retry, pending texture completion, browser loading errors and resource cleanup. A desktop or emulated-mobile run does not prove physical Android behavior.
- [ ] Confirm all mandatory CI checks, including four browser shards and aggregation, pass on the proposed update. The PR must accurately report tests and any known skipped or unperformed checks; no new human approval gate or unrelated feature work.

## Definition of done

The MMD/glTF demo reproducibly installs **published `@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.4`**, references the correct version in current docs, and maintains functional Uka/Gene direct-PMX vs glTF comparison across its existing controls and workflows. Any legitimate upstream 0.1.4 lighting changes are explained with evidence rather than hidden; no unrelated features or compatibility shims are introduced.

## Post-merge verification

After an authorized merge, check the exact `main` SHA's required CI + Pages deployment, load the published demo for Uka/Gene, confirm both MMD/glTF panes reach Ready and original textures load, and verify that deployed build provenance corresponds to the **0.1.4-locked** source. Record actual success/failure and platform limits.
